layout.convention: Robot frame: front/OLED toward screen top, USB/back toward bottom; the robot's own left/right align with screen left/right. Front hips L1/R1, rear hips L2/R2. Placement illustration, not released body geometry.

assumptions: Same discrete elastic-rod solver as OLED/battery leads. Illustrative fixed-length quasi-static segments with pinned exits, authored inner-side routing guides and native-part collision penalties. Routing guides encode the intended manual arrangement, not extra physical fasteners. Servo ribbon uses three-wire effective bending and a conservative width envelope; PVC-web torsion, cable-to-cable contact, purchased dimensions and dynamic inertia are unverified. Animation interpolates solved poses, not live physics.
